name: Bookify – Premium Scheduling Appointment Booking System | Appointment Booking Plugin
author: Bookify

sections.description:
Looking for an all-in-one booking plugin? If yes, then your journey has ended! Download Bookify NOW and make the reservation booking process a hassle-free task.

Bookify is a premium appointment booking system that helps your customers schedule, automate, and book appointments on your website. This online appointment plugin lets you manage various business services, design different booking forms, serve your client base, and save on scheduling costs.

Join hundreds and thousands of online businesses across the globe that are already serving their clients through this seamless appointment booking system.

💰 Revenue-Enhancing Appointment Booking Plugin

The major purpose of building Bookify is to make appointment booking easy. This booking system is a one-window solution for all types of businesses, including law consultants, spas and salons, clinics, ticket booking systems, and more.

Bookify is an easy-to-use WordPress appointment booking plugin with an intuitive design that offers your clients a unique and seamless booking experience.

The booking calendar of Bookify brings in services in a systematically organized manner, empowering your customers to book the time slots conveniently for their online bookings or to reserve seats for various events.

The free version is a simple appointment scheduling system. After scaling your business, you can seamlessly upgrade to the Bookify Pro, which includes various premium add-ons for an effortless and powerful client scheduling process.

That is not all! Wait for the full range of features below!

🎉 Key Features of Bookify – A Complete Online Appointment System

✔ As an admin, you can see a list of all appointments in the Appointments menu and easily find any appointment through the search tool and filters.
✔ Easily add multiple appointments for the date you want via Calendar on behalf of your customers and staffs.
✔ Multiple appointment services option that you can book for different categories.
✔ Analyze your business and make informed decisions based on stats displayed on the dashboard.
✔ Neat and insightful widgets, charts, and tables allow checking the performance at a glance.
✔ Create your own services with multi-level service categories. With the perfect structure, you can easily categorize your business services in this booking plugin.
✔ Export customers’ data to a CSV file whenever you want. Alternatively, you can add new customers from a CSV file using the import function.
✔ Modify the booking panel on your website to fit your business needs via this appointment scheduling plugin.

📌 Appointment Booking System That Offers Easy-to-Embed Shortcodes

Bookify is a WordPress booking plugin that allows booking form access through shortcodes.

Shortcode to access Bookify Form
Bookify enables users to access appointment booking form by using the following shortcode:
[bookify_bookings]

Shortcode to view list of booked appointments
Bookify enables registered users to see the list of their previously booked appointments by using the following shortcode:
[bookify_appointments]

🚀 Benefits of Using Bookify as Your Online Booking System

Online scheduling is made easy with Bookify! All your customers need to do is select the ‘service type’ and ‘time slot’ they want. Then fill out a brief personal information online booking form, and that’s it— you’re done!

Bookify is a seamlessly responsive WordPress appointment booking plugin! Before the meeting time, your clients will receive an automated email notification, and the appointment will be automatically entered into your appointment scheduling calendar.

In summary, here are the major benefits you will get from this WordPress online appointment scheduling system:

  • Instantly schedule and book appointments online without getting in touch with admin or your staff;
  • Bookify’s responsive booking form and overall design allows users to navigate through this booking system easily;
  • Choose the employee, the service, and the category to book appointments and reservations;
  • Specifying custom dates and time slots are the highlights of this WordPress booking system. Bookify will only display available staff timings;
  • Provide easy-to-fill contact information;
  • Receive email notifications of their online scheduling or reservations;
  • Receive reminders via emails about upcoming scheduled bookings.
  • With email follow-ups and reminders, the days of no-shows are over.
  • Website administrators and developers adore Bookify’s WordPress admin panel because it is simple to use.
  • Find all your scheduled appointments easily by using the convenient search tool and filters.

💲 Who Can Benefit From Bookify – A Premium Appointment System

Bookify has been developed to facilitate small- to large-scale businesses and individual service providers. This WordPress booking system is fully customizable. This booking plugin can be successfully applied to various business segments, a few of which are mentioned below:

✨ Personal care
✨ Healthcare
✨ Education
✨ Consultancy
✨ Freelancers

Also, Bookify is the best appointment booking plugin for web developers who want to improve their appointment scheduling process to close clients effortlessly.

🚀 Industries That Can Use This Appointment Booking Plugin

⭐ Spa & Salons – the characteristics of our WordPress booking system impress salon owners as their customers pay them on schedule due to Bookify’s payment integrations. Also, this booking plugin eliminates duplicate appointment booking while automated alerts make running a beauty spa and salon easier than ever before.

⭐ Therapists & legal consultants – Therapists and legal consultants admire our booking system as it enables them to include group appointments (since Bookify helps to cater to multiple bookings simultaneously). Recurring appointment bookings allow legal consultants to consistently accommodate their valued clients and provide them with financial stability.

⭐ Dental and clinic appointments – Because they can focus on providing patients with the best care possible without worrying about management, dental and healthcare professionals love using our WordPress booking plugin. Its features, like custom input fields and multiple bookings for clinic staff, help them provide top-notch scheduling services.

⭐ Tutor booking – Our booking capabilities are popular with educators since it lets them book sessions both personally and in groups without worrying about admin work and display their open slots calendar.

⭐ Gym and Sports – Fitness enthusiasts and sports lovers admire our online WordPress booking plugin because they can book clients 24/7. Moreover, they can send reminders via email notifications, so there is zero possibility of no-shows while getting amazing results.

⭐ Entertainment ticket booking – With features like payment integrations and reservation through search tools, businesses dealing in ticket bookings for movies and entertainment may take advantage of an intuitive ticket booking system that is straightforward to use.

⭐ Restaurant bookings – Bookify is perfect for restaurant service providers for easy appointment scheduling with its built-in calendar. Bookify enables their clients to schedule appointments related to seat reservations round-the-clock and helps them provide top-notch restaurant booking services.

⭐ Bus or cab booking – Transport service booking has never been this much easier than with this bus or cab booking system because it offers rich features like instant ticket booking and payment receipts.

In essence, Bookify is a one-stop shop for virtually every business. This appointment booking system handles online payments, calendar booking, and scheduling events on one platform. As an extensive schedule booking plugin, Bookify is a useful blend of basic and advanced booking features to handle event booking needs.

⚡ Key Features of Bookify Pro – RELEASING SOON

Here are the features that will be available to Bookify Pro – the premium version of this WordPress booking plugin:

✅ Custom Form Fields
✅ Google Calandar Integration
✅ Outlook Calendar Integration
✅ Coupons for offers and discounts
✅ Google Meet
✅ Zoom
✅ Microsoft Teams
✅ SMS Notification
✅ WhatsApp Notification

⚡ Automated Email Notifications & Reminders

  • Email Notifications: Bookify lets you send scheduling reminders, reschedule updates, and book confirmations.
  • Custom Notification Settings: Customize booking alerts based on reservation status.
  • SMS Notifications (Pro): Notify guests by SMS or WhatsApp by downloading Bookify (releasing soon).

⚡ Booking Payment Options

  • Top Online Payment Options: Bookify facilitates simple online transactions with support for Stripe and PayPal.
  • Flexible payment: Either pay online or on-site; the choice is yours.

⚡ Essential Integration of Tools

Bookify offers leading tool integrations to streamline your event booking scheduling:

  • CRM Integration: Integrate your business website with CRMs like Zoho (coming).
  • Calendar sync for appointments: Connect Outlook and Google calendars to prevent double reservations.
  • Video Conferencing: Connect with Zoom for online bookings (releasing soon).

⚡ Export and View Booking Information

  • List and Calendar Views: Show appointments by calendar or list, arranged according to daily, weekly, or monthly schedules.
  • Data Export: For in-depth analysis, export booking details in CSV.
  • Custom filters: Use custom filters to find appointments by staff, date, or other criteria.

⚡ Bookings

  • Send notification emails to customers related to requests received and requests confirmed or rejected.
  • Access the booking log for a user’s appointment.

💻 Easy & Helpful Dashboard Analytics

Monitor and evaluate your business success right from your dashboard via Bookify:

📈 Booking Insights in Real Time: Track scheduled reservations, earnings, abandoned and completed appointments. You can monitor statistics on a weekly, daily, or monthly basis.

📈 Productivity Analytics: Trends and patterns in bookings are revealed by visual reports.

📈 Instant Alerts: Get up-to-date information about online reservations and site activities in real time.

🤝 Forms for Appointment Bookings

Use an easily understandable appointment booking form for a simplified booking process.

  • Use the appointment calendar from Outlook or Google to select an event.
  • Collect key user data through booking form integrations.
  • Use insights of booking forms to improve client service.

⚡ Advanced Appointment Scheduling Options

Create and handle your appointment schedule with ease so you can concentrate on providing high-quality service.

  • Select available hours and days for appointment bookings.
  • Set available and specific date ranges.
  • Add special days to the calendar, like public holidays and off days.
  • Modify appointment booking descriptions to explain your services better.
  • Include interval or break times between appointments.
  • Lock time zones and restrict booking frequency if needed.
  • Adjust and offer time zones for users, ensuring accuracy.

In summary, this appointment plugin is the most user-friendly WordPress booking plugin since it offers a comprehensive solution to improve your scheduling system and expedite your booking procedure.

⚡ 3rd Party Services

MUI – https://mui.com/material-ui/
ApexCharts – https://apexcharts.com/
FullCalendar – https://fullcalendar.io/

✔ For Developers

The source code for the React application is located in the src folder in the main directory of the plugin, which is structured as follows:

  • admin/: Contains all modules for managing the plugin in the WordPress admin dashboard.
  • frontend/: Responsible for the main booking forms used by end-users.
  • appointment/: Manages the table of booked appointments and related functionality.

Steps to Run the React Application:

1: To Install Dependencies
Open your console, navigate to the plugin directory, and run: npm install
This will install all the required npm packages for the React application.

2: Run in Development Mode
To build and run the React app in development mode, execute: npm run start
This will launch a development server with hot reloading for React.

3: Build for Production
If you’re preparing the plugin for production, run: npm run build
This command will generate an optimized, production-ready build of the React app.
